description: Posts a signed sample of one event (event, default the webhook's first; livemode: false) to one webhook (webhook_id from read webhooks), as Send test event does, and answers the receiver's status code and reply excerpt. The attempt shows in read webhook_deliveries. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: webhook_test
title: Send a test event to a webhook
